claims: K-pop blends pop, hip-hop, R&B, and electronic styles.
K-pop is known for high-production music videos.
K-pop is known for synchronized choreography.
K-pop is known for rigorous training systems for idols.
Major K-pop groups include BTS, BLACKPINK, Stray Kids, and Twice.
Popular groups frequently mentioned include EXO, SEVENTEEN, NCT, Red Velvet, LE SSERAFIM, IVE, and NewJeans, as shown on Spotify charts.
HYBE, SM Entertainment, JYP Entertainment, and YG Entertainment oversee the training and production of idol groups.
There is a 2026 Netflix movie titled KPop Demon Hunters.
The soundtrack of the 2026 Netflix movie KPop Demon Hunters won a Grammy.
